defects.literal: Оставленный мусор тоже становится доступной животным человеческой пищей и связан с плохим питанием и болезнями.
defects.finding: The note attaches both poor nourishment and diseases to accessible trash/human food. NPS L43-L44 directly supports accessible trash/human food and poor nourishment/shorter lives. L32 separately associates proximity to people/developed areas with greater risk of eating human food AND catching diseases from people/pets (and transmitting them). It does not say that discarded food/trash or eating it is the disease link. The current note collapses those distinct exposure routes into an unqualified association. This is insufficient primary grounding for that exact whole note; no assertion here that garbage can never carry pathogens.
defects.neededEvidenceOrDecision: A primary statement supporting the disease association in the exact note, or a human-authorized later correction to keep only directly supported food/trash harms. Do not run an ordinary unchanged cycle2.
